# Test fixture license

`four-language.wav` was generated for this repository from zero-valued PCM samples. It is one second of 16 kHz, mono, signed 16-bit silence and contains no recording, speech, music, third-party material, or personal data.

Copyright 2026 the Voice Project contributors. You may use, copy, modify, and distribute this fixture under the same terms as the repository source code.

The filename identifies the application's four-language test selection; it does **not** claim that the file contains spoken Vietnamese, English, Spanish, or Chinese. It is deliberately a deterministic transport/lifecycle fixture, not an accuracy corpus.

`jfk.wav` is copied unchanged from `samples/jfk.wav` in the vendored [whisper.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp) project. The source file and whisper.cpp are distributed under the following MIT License:
